content: Yerusalaame Kundethaa
Sedeqiyaasi Yihudan kawotida uddufuntho laythan, tammantha ageenan, Babiloone kawoy Nabukadanaxoorinne iya olanchoti ubbay yidi, Yerusalaame teqidosona.
Sedeqiyaasi kawotida tammanne issintho laythan, oyddantho ageenan, uddufuntho gallasan Babiloone olanchoti katama gimbiya menthidosona.
He wode Babiloone kawa halaqati, Ergaal-Sarasira, Samgaar-Nabo, Sarsakimanne Ergaal-Sarasira geeteteysati hara daro halaqatara issife yidi Giddo Penge geetetiya bessan uttidosona.

Yihuda kawoy Sedeqiyaasinne iya olanchoti ubbay Babiloone olanchota be7ida wode baqatidosona. Qamma katamaape keyidi, kawa atakilte bessaa efiya ogiyara, nam7u dirsa gimbeta issife gathiya pengiyara keyidi Yordaanose Zangaarako simmidi bidosona.

Gidoshin, Babiloone olanchoti enta yedethidi, Iyaarko demba gathishe, Sedeqiyaasa oykidosona. Hamaata biittan, Irbila kataman de7iya kawa Nabukadanaxoorako efidosona. Kawoy Nabukadanaxoori yan Sedeqiyaasa bolla pirdis.
Babiloone kawoy, Sedeqiyaasa ade nayta iya sinthan, Irbila kataman wodhis; qassi Yihuda halaqata ubbaa wodhis.
Sedeqiyaasa ayfeta wooci kessidi, iya Babiloone biitta efanaw santhalaatan qachis.
Babiloone olanchoti kawo gadhonne asay de7iya keetha ubbaa taman xuuggidosona; Yerusalaame gimbiyaka laallidosona.
Kawa naageysata halaqay Nabuzardaani kataman attida asaanne kaddidi iyako yida asa ubbaa di77idi Babiloone biitta efis.
Kawa naageysata halaqay Nabuzardaani aykoka bayna guutha manqota Yihudan aggidi, entaw woyne gadenne goshsha gade immis.
Ermiyaasi Biletis
Nabukadanaxoori, kawa naageysata halaqaa Nabuzardaana haysada yaagidi kiittis:
“Bada Ermiyaasa koya demmada, iyaw koshshiyaba ubbaa ootha; iya bolla hara iitabaa aykoka oothofa” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Nabuzardaani, Nabushazbaana, Ergaal-Sarasiranne Babiloone kawa halaqata ubbaa kiittidi,

Ermiyaasa qashetidi de7iya, naageysata dabaabape kessidosona. Ba soo efidi wothana mela Safaana na7aa, Akqaama na7aa Godoliyas hadara immidosona. Hessa gaason, Ermiyaasi ba biitta asaara issife de7is.
Ermiyaasi naageysata dabaaban qashetidi de7ishin, Godaa qaalay iyako haysada yaagidi yis.

“Bada, Tophe addiya Ebemelekako haysada yaaga: ‘Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday, Isra7eele Xoossay, haysada yaagees: hizape guye ta odidaysada ha katamaa bolla lo77oba gidonashin, dhayo ehana. Hessi ubbay haniya wode ne ha kataman uttada, ne ayfen be7ana.
Gidoshin, he gallas ta nena ashshana; ne yayiya, ne morketa kushen aathada immike.
Ta nena polo ashshana; ne olan hayqaka; ne tanan ammanetida gisho, hayqope attana’ ” yaagees Goday.
